verdict.rationale: Pendo's first-party docs describe Session Replay for watching real user sessions click by click, with frustration signals, segment and account filters, and links from funnel drop-offs, NPS responses and feedback. Masking runs on the device before data leaves it, with no-code privacy levels (Maximum Privacy, Inputs Only, Minimum Privacy). The docs never say which level is the default, so 'masked by default' is not confirmed. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that sensitive input masking is on by default, independent or hands-on corroboration of replay and masking behavior.
